purpose: Current shared ability catalogue. Portable TypeScript assignments supply executable parameters; the balance review records recommendations separately.

abilities.name: Heal / Clear Condition
abilities.effect: Restore 1 Health, or clear one tactical condition. Choose the mode when assigning the ability.
options: paid activity, attack rider, or once-per-battle activation-start condition clear
abilities.limits: Health recovery once per recipient per battle, up to battle-start tactical Health; condition recovery once per recipient per round. Never revive a destroyed unit or erase campaign wounds. An activation-start condition clear has a once-per-battle limit.
abilities.primitive: Implemented by the shared troop ability interpreter; numerical values remain playtest values.

abilities.name: Damage Absorption
abilities.effect: Gain a buffer that absorbs the next 1 Health of damage. It expires at the start of the recipient's next activation.
options: on attack use, after damage, paid activity, or recipient activation start from an adjacent ally
abilities.limits: One buffer per recipient, at most one grant per round. Absorbs damage after existing damage caps. Never restores Health or persists into campaign state.
abilities.primitive: Implemented by the shared troop ability interpreter; numerical values remain playtest values.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.effect: At activation start, while below battle-start Health, attempt a Fortitude save against the DC for the unit’s own level. Success or critical success restores 1 Health; failure restores nothing.
options: always active or a source environmental requirement
source damage tags that suppress recovery
abilities.limits: One attempt per round, including failed saves. Losing Health to any Blast skips recovery at the next activation. Repeated hits refresh that interruption without adding skipped activations; misses and fully absorbed Blasts do not interrupt recovery. Source damage counters and environmental requirements still apply. Never revive a destroyed unit or heal above battle-start Health. This recurring recovery is separate from Heal’s once-per-battle allowance.
abilities.primitive: Implemented by the shared troop ability interpreter; numerical values remain playtest values.

abilities.name: Delayed Damage
abilities.effect: Apply 1 pending damage at the end of the target’s next activation. Multiple marks share one pending hit.
options: fire, poison, bleed, or other source damage tag
abilities.limits: One pending persistent effect per recipient. Preserve the game's recovery and damage timing; omit PF2e affliction stages and repeated damage dice.
abilities.primitive: Implemented by the shared troop ability interpreter; numerical values remain playtest values.

abilities.name: Fear
abilities.effect: Apply the game's frightened condition: -1 to rolls and Defence through the target's next activation.
abilities.limits: One frightened condition. An aura sustains it only while adjacent and active. Fear immunity applies. This does not write campaign Demoralized or directly remove Morale.
abilities.primitive: Implemented by the shared troop ability interpreter; numerical values remain playtest values.

abilities.name: Weaken Defence
abilities.effect: The target suffers -2 Defence until it next acts.
abilities.limits: Use existing exposure and cover rules. Refresh instead of adding; omit separate prone, clumsy, and off-guard tracks.
abilities.primitive: Implemented by the shared troop ability interpreter; numerical values remain playtest values.

abilities.name: Suppression
abilities.effect: Apply -2 to rolls and Defence until the source next acts.
abilities.limits: One suppression effect. Use the game's existing -2 penalty; omit graded enfeebled, stupefied, and sickened values. A replacement deals zero normal damage.
abilities.primitive: Implemented by the shared troop ability interpreter; numerical values remain playtest values.

abilities.name: Immobilize
abilities.effect: Prevent movement through the target’s next activation. The target can still attack and can spend one action to break free.
abilities.limits: One root. No carried targets, grapple stages, Escape DCs, or action-loss track. Do not add the pinning shooter's free shot.
abilities.primitive: Implemented by the shared troop ability interpreter; numerical values remain playtest values.

abilities.name: Push / Pull
abilities.effect: Move the target one legal hex away from or toward the source after a qualifying hit.
abilities.limits: Never stack distance or force illegal occupancy. A blocked destination leaves the target in place; this ability adds no collision damage.
abilities.primitive: Implemented by the shared troop ability interpreter; numerical values remain playtest values.

abilities.name: Guard
abilities.effect: Use Guard, or share its +2 protection with one adjacent ally while guarding.
options: on attack use until next activation
abilities.limits: One Guard benefit per recipient. Require shields only when the source does. An attached defensive rider never creates another action.
abilities.primitive: Implemented by the shared troop ability interpreter; numerical values remain playtest values.

abilities.name: Resist Fear and Rout / Hold Ground
abilities.effect: Choose +2 on checks to resist fear or rout, ignore the first forced displacement each round, or both.
abilities.limits: Choose the mode at assignment. It never grants pursuit, prevents defeat, or grants blanket Morale immunity. Duplicate bonuses do not add.
abilities.primitive: Implemented by the shared troop ability interpreter; numerical values remain playtest values.

abilities.name: Cavalry Charge
abilities.effect: Use the existing cavalry-charge impact benefit on a legal Charge.
abilities.limits: Preserve the game's Charge cost, route rules, and attack limit. Omit extra PF2e Strides and automatic knockdown.
abilities.primitive: Implemented by the shared troop ability interpreter; numerical values remain playtest values.

abilities.name: Terrain Passage
abilities.effect: Ignore ordinary difficult terrain in one assigned terrain group.
options: all ordinary ground when the source warrants it
abilities.limits: Never grants flight, swimming, water walking, wall passage, hazard immunity, or shared occupancy. Use a movement mode the unit already has.
abilities.primitive: Implemented by the shared troop ability interpreter; numerical values remain playtest values.

abilities.name: Opening Move
abilities.effect: In the first activation of the battle’s first round, make one free Move before other actions.
options: only when acting before all enemies
only when deployed in water or swamp
abilities.limits: Once per battle. Respect legal paths; start and finish outside enemy contact. It grants no attack.
abilities.primitive: Implemented by the shared troop ability interpreter; numerical values remain playtest values.

abilities.name: Combat Bonus
abilities.effect: Gain +1 to the assigned attack, Defence, opening initiative comparison, or Fear save difficulty, subject to the assigned condition.
options: melee, volley, spell attack, Defence, opening initiative, or Fear activity save difficulty
a condition from the supported list, or always active
abilities.limits: One Combat Bonus bonus per check. Select a predicate from the closed list; no free-form scripts. Adjacent command support may grant the same bonus to allies without stacking.
abilities.primitive: Implemented by the shared troop ability interpreter; numerical values remain playtest values.

abilities.name: Siege Accuracy
abilities.effect: Gain +1 to the first attack check each activation with a siege engine this unit operates.
abilities.limits: Siege Training, Practiced Gunners, and Practiced Loaders collapse to one benefit. Keep normal load costs and firing limits. No benefit when the unit lacks an engine.
abilities.primitive: Implemented by the shared troop ability interpreter; numerical values remain playtest values.

reactionPatterns.name: Retaliate
reactionPatterns.effect: Make one ordinary melee attack when an adjacent enemy exposes itself by moving or using a vulnerable activity.
reactionPatterns.omit: PF2e reach geometry and critical manipulation interruption.

reactionPatterns.name: Pursue
reactionPatterns.effect: Follow a departing adjacent enemy with one legal Move.
reactionPatterns.omit: No Retreat is not a pursuit source.

reactionPatterns.name: Block
reactionPatterns.effect: Reduce incoming physical damage by 1 Health after the result is known.
reactionPatterns.omit: Shield Hardness, shield damage, and the DC 17 critical downgrade check. Retain shield/raised and critical-hit prerequisites respectively.

reactionPatterns.name: Counterplay
reactionPatterns.effect: After successfully resisting rout, apply Weaken Defence to the attacker.
reactionPatterns.omit: The follow-up Deception check, failed feint penalty, and disabling enemy reactions.

reactionPatterns.name: Battle Recovery
reactionPatterns.effect: After a critical melee result, Heal self and spend its normal per-battle allowance.

reactionPatterns.name: Hold Nerve
reactionPatterns.effect: Prevent an incoming frightened condition while this unit is not routed.

reactionPatterns.name: Coordinated Advance
reactionPatterns.effect: A paid command lets one adjacent ally spend its reaction to make one legal Move.
reactionPatterns.omit: Mass movement within 60 feet and separate Stand/Step options.
